title: Cleopatra lived closer to us than to the pyramid builders
description:
The Great Pyramid was built around 2560 BC, Cleopatra died in 30 BC, and humans landed on the Moon in 1969. We do the math and see just how long Egypt's history really is.
#history #ancientegypt #cleopatra #shorts

scenes.narration: Cleopatra lived closer to you than to the pyramid builders.

scenes.narration: The Great Pyramid of Pharaoh Khufu at Giza was built around twenty-five sixty BC.
scenes.imagePrompt: great pyramid of giza at dawn, low sun, long shadows, fine sand haze, epic wide shot, deep midnight blue palette with cyan highlights, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, no text

scenes.narration: For more than thirty-eight hundred years, it stayed the tallest structure humans had ever built.
scenes.imagePrompt: close-up of massive weathered limestone blocks of an ancient pyramid, dramatic side light, deep midnight blue palette with cyan highlights, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, no text

scenes.narration: Cleopatra died in thirty BC. That's roughly twenty-five hundred years after the pyramid went up.
scenes.imagePrompt: ancient papyrus scroll and an hourglass on a stone table, candle light, deep midnight blue palette with cyan highlights, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, no text

scenes.narration: But from Cleopatra to the Moon landing in nineteen sixty-nine? Less than two thousand years.

scenes.narration: To Cleopatra herself, the pyramids were already ancient. Herodotus wrote about them four centuries before her time.

scenes.narration: So Egypt's history is so long that Cleopatra is more our contemporary than the pyramid builders'.
